Question: Using NHANES from 2007 to 2018 we will run a weighted logistic regression using exam weights where the predictor is weight adjusted waist ratio which is calculated as waist circumference (cm) divide by the square root of weight(kg), categorized as quartiles(%) Q1: ≤25, Q2: >25 and ≤50, Q3: >50 and ≤75, Q4: >75. The outcome of interest is the presence of kidney disease, defined as either an estimated glomerular filtration rate (eGFR) below 60 mL/min/1.73m^2 or a urine albumin-to-creatinine ratio (UACR) (mg/g) of 30 mg/g or greater.  eGFR can be calculated using gender, serum creatinine (mg/dl), age, race information for 4 different cases: 1. if gender is female and race is black : 141 * min(serum creatinine (mg/dl) / 0.7, 1) ** -0.329 * max(serum creatinine (mg/dl) / 0.7, 1) ** -1.209 * (0.993 ** age) * 1.018 * 1.159 2. if gender is female and race is not black : 141 * min(serum creatinine (mg/dl) / 0.7, 1) ** -0.329 * max(serum creatinine (mg/dl) / 0.7, 1) ** -1.209 * (0.993 ** age) * 1.018 3. if gender is male and race is black : 141 * min(serum creatinine (mg/dl) / 0.9, 1) ** -0.411 * max(serum creatinine (mg/dl) / 0.9, 1) ** -1.209 * (0.993 ** age) * 1.159 4. if gender is male and race is not black : 141 * min(serum creatinine (mg/dl) / 0.9, 1) ** -0.411 * max(serum creatinine (mg/dl) / 0.9, 1) ** -1.209 * (0.993 ** age).  Urine albumin-to-creatinine ratio (mg/g) is calculated as 100*(urine albumin mg/L / urine creatinine mg/dL). Covariates include race categorized as white or non white, age categorized as less than 60 and 60 or more, and gender. We will include diabetes patients where diabetes was defined as one of the following: self-reported doctor diagnosis of diabetes, or fasting plasma glucose (FPG, mmol/L) ≥7.0 mmol/L, or glycohemoglobin≥6.5%, or the use of diabetes medication. We will exclude participants under the age of 20, pregnant, as well as those without data on WWI index that requires waist circumference (cm) and weight (kg), urinary albumin to urinary creatinine ratio that requires urine albumin (mg/L) and urine creatinine (mg/dL), missing  eGFR that requires, age, race, gender, serum creatinine (mg/dl).

    t0."doctor_told_you_have_diabetes",
    t1."fasting_glucose_mmol_l",
    t2."glycohemoglobin",

    t10."race_hispanic_origin",
    t11."gender",
    t12."creatinine_mg_dl"
FROM temp_all_ids a
LEFT JOIN temp_master_doctor_told_you_have_diabetes t0 ON a.respondent_sequence_number = t0.respondent_sequence_number 
LEFT JOIN temp_master_fasting_glucose_mmol_l t1 ON a.respondent_sequence_number = t1.respondent_sequence_number 
LEFT JOIN temp_master_glycohemoglobin t2 ON a.respondent_sequence_number = t2.respondent_sequence_number 
LEFT JOIN temp_master_take_diabetic_pills_to_lower_blood_sugar t3 ON a.respondent_sequence_number = t3.respondent_sequence_number

LEFT JOIN temp_master_are_you_pregnant_now t5 ON a.respondent_sequence_number = t5.respondent_sequence_number 
LEFT JOIN temp_master_waist_circumference_cm t6 ON a.respondent_sequence_number = t6.respondent_sequence_number 
LEFT JOIN temp_master_weight_kg t7 ON a.respondent_sequence_number = t7.respondent_sequence_number 
LEFT JOIN temp_master_albumin_urine_mg_l t8 ON a.respondent_sequence_number = t8.respondent_sequence_number 
LEFT JOIN temp_master_creatinine_urine_mg_dl t9 ON a.respondent_sequence_number = t9.respondent_sequence_number 
LEFT JOIN temp_master_race_hispanic_origin t10 ON a.respondent_sequence_number = t10.respondent_sequence_number

CREATE INDEX idx_final_master_respondent_sequence_number    
    ON final_master_table (respondent_sequence_number);


-- Clean up final_master_table
DELETE FROM final_master_table
WHERE respondent_sequence_number NOT IN (

-- ========== STEP 1: Inclusion ==========

-- STEP 1.1: Include patients with diabetes based on specified criteria
CREATE TEMP TABLE temp_inclusion_step1 AS
SELECT
    f."respondent_sequence_number"
FROM
    final_master_table f
WHERE
    f."doctor_told_you_have_diabetes" = 'Yes'
    OR f."fasting_glucose_mmol_l" >= 7.0
    OR f."glycohemoglobin" >= 6.5
    OR f."take_diabetic_pills_to_lower_blood_sugar" = 'Yes';

-- ========== STEP 2: Exclusions ==========

-- STEP 2.1: Exclude participants under the age of 20
CREATE TEMP TABLE temp_exclusion_step1 AS
SELECT
    i."respondent_sequence_number"
FROM
    temp_inclusion_step1 i
JOIN
    final_master_table f ON i."respondent_sequence_number" = f."respondent_sequence_number"
WHERE
    f."age_in_years_at_screening" IS NULL OR f."age_in_years_at_screening" >= 20;

-- STEP 2.2: Exclude pregnant participants
CREATE TEMP TABLE temp_exclusion_step2 AS
SELECT
    i."respondent_sequence_number"
FROM
    temp_exclusion_step1 i
JOIN
    final_master_table f ON i."respondent_sequence_number" = f."respondent_sequence_number"
WHERE
    f."are_you_pregnant_now" IS NULL OR f."are_you_pregnant_now" != 'Yes';

-- STEP 2.3: Exclude participants with missing waist circumference or weight
CREATE TEMP TABLE temp_exclusion_step3 AS
SELECT
    i."respondent_sequence_number"
FROM
    temp_exclusion_step2 i
JOIN
    final_master_table f ON i."respondent_sequence_number" = f."respondent_sequence_number"
WHERE
    f."waist_circumference_cm" IS NOT NULL
    AND f."weight_kg" IS NOT NULL;

-- STEP 2.4: Exclude participants with missing urine albumin or creatinine
CREATE TEMP TABLE temp_exclusion_step4 AS
SELECT
    i."respondent_sequence_number"
FROM
    temp_exclusion_step3 i
JOIN
    final_master_table f ON i."respondent_sequence_number" = f."respondent_sequence_number"
WHERE
    f."albumin_urine_mg_l" IS NOT NULL
    AND f."creatinine_urine_mg_dl" IS NOT NULL;

-- STEP 2.5: Exclude participants with missing age, race, gender, or serum creatinine
CREATE TEMP TABLE temp_exclusion_step5 AS
SELECT
    i."respondent_sequence_number"
FROM
    temp_exclusion_step4 i
JOIN
    final_master_table f ON i."respondent_sequence_number" = f."respondent_sequence_number"
WHERE
    f."age_in_years_at_screening" IS NOT NULL
    AND f."race_hispanic_origin" IS NOT NULL
    AND f."gender" IS NOT NULL
    AND f."creatinine_mg_dl" IS NOT NULL;

-- ========== STEP 3: Cohort ==========

-- The final temp table in the exclusion sequence becomes temp_cohort.
CREATE TEMP TABLE temp_cohort AS
SELECT
    "respondent_sequence_number"
FROM
    temp_exclusion_step5;

-- ========== STEP 4: Variables ==========

-- 4.1 Covariate: Race
-- Map race to 'white' or 'non white'
CREATE TEMP TABLE temp_race AS
SELECT
    c."respondent_sequence_number",
    CASE
        WHEN f."race_hispanic_origin" = 'Non-Hispanic White' THEN 'white'
        WHEN f."race_hispanic_origin" IS NULL THEN NULL
        ELSE 'non white'
    END AS "race"
FROM
    temp_cohort c
JOIN
    final_master_table f ON c."respondent_sequence_number" = f."respondent_sequence_number";

-- 4.2 Covariate: Age
-- Map age to 'less than 60' or '60 or more'
CREATE TEMP TABLE temp_age AS
SELECT
    c."respondent_sequence_number",
    CASE
        WHEN f."age_in_years_at_screening" < 60 THEN 'less than 60'
        WHEN f."age_in_years_at_screening" >= 60 THEN '60 or more'
        ELSE NULL
    END AS "age"
FROM
    temp_cohort c
JOIN
    final_master_table f ON c."respondent_sequence_number" = f."respondent_sequence_number";

-- 4.3 Covariate: Gender
-- Extract gender
CREATE TEMP TABLE temp_gender AS
SELECT
    c."respondent_sequence_number",
    f."gender"
FROM
    temp_cohort c
JOIN
    final_master_table f ON c."respondent_sequence_number" = f."respondent_sequence_number";

-- 4.4 Predictor: Weight Adjusted Waist Ratio
-- Calculate raw weight adjusted waist ratio
CREATE TEMP TABLE temp_weight_adjusted_waist_ratio_raw AS
SELECT
    c."respondent_sequence_number",
    f."waist_circumference_cm" / SQRT(f."weight_kg") AS "weight_adjusted_waist_ratio_value"
FROM
    temp_cohort c
JOIN
    final_master_table f ON c."respondent_sequence_number" = f."respondent_sequence_number"
WHERE
    f."waist_circumference_cm" IS NOT NULL
    AND f."weight_kg" IS NOT NULL
    AND f."weight_kg" > 0; -- Ensure no division by zero or sqrt of negative

-- Compute quartile cutoffs for weight adjusted waist ratio within cohort
CREATE TEMP TABLE temp_weight_adjusted_waist_ratio_cutoffs AS
SELECT
    PERCENTILE_CONT(0.25) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY "weight_adjusted_waist_ratio_value") AS q1,
    PERCENTILE_CONT(0.50) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY "weight_adjusted_waist_ratio_value") AS q2,
    PERCENTILE_CONT(0.75) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY "weight_adjusted_waist_ratio_value") AS q3
FROM
    temp_weight_adjusted_waist_ratio_raw;

-- Assign weight adjusted waist ratio quartile group
CREATE TEMP TABLE temp_weight_adjusted_waist_ratio AS
SELECT
    r."respondent_sequence_number",
    CASE
        WHEN r."weight_adjusted_waist_ratio_value" IS NULL THEN NULL
        WHEN r."weight_adjusted_waist_ratio_value" <= (SELECT q1 FROM temp_weight_adjusted_waist_ratio_cutoffs) THEN 'Q1: <=25%'
        WHEN r."weight_adjusted_waist_ratio_value" <= (SELECT q2 FROM temp_weight_adjusted_waist_ratio_cutoffs) THEN 'Q2: >25% and <=50%'
        WHEN r."weight_adjusted_waist_ratio_value" <= (SELECT q3 FROM temp_weight_adjusted_waist_ratio_cutoffs) THEN 'Q3: >50% and <=75%'
        ELSE 'Q4: >75%'
    END AS "weight_adjusted_waist_ratio"
FROM
    temp_weight_adjusted_waist_ratio_raw r;

-- 4.5 Outcome: Presence of Kidney Disease
-- Step 4.5.1: Calculate eGFR
CREATE TEMP TABLE temp_egfr AS
SELECT
    c."respondent_sequence_number",
    CASE
        WHEN f."gender" = 'Female' AND f."race_hispanic_origin" = 'Non-Hispanic Black' THEN
            141 * POWER(LEAST(f."creatinine_mg_dl" / 0.7, 1), -0.329) * POWER(GREATEST(f."creatinine_mg_dl" / 0.7, 1), -1.209) * POWER(0.993, f."age_in_years_at_screening") * 1.018 * 1.159
        WHEN f."gender" = 'Female' AND f."race_hispanic_origin" != 'Non-Hispanic Black' THEN
            141 * POWER(LEAST(f."creatinine_mg_dl" / 0.7, 1), -0.329) * POWER(GREATEST(f."creatinine_mg_dl" / 0.7, 1), -1.209) * POWER(0.993, f."age_in_years_at_screening") * 1.018
        WHEN f."gender" = 'Male' AND f."race_hispanic_origin" = 'Non-Hispanic Black' THEN
            141 * POWER(LEAST(f."creatinine_mg_dl" / 0.9, 1), -0.411) * POWER(GREATEST(f."creatinine_mg_dl" / 0.9, 1), -1.209) * POWER(0.993, f."age_in_years_at_screening") * 1.159
        WHEN f."gender" = 'Male' AND f."race_hispanic_origin" != 'Non-Hispanic Black' THEN
            141 * POWER(LEAST(f."creatinine_mg_dl" / 0.9, 1), -0.411) * POWER(GREATEST(f."creatinine_mg_dl" / 0.9, 1), -1.209) * POWER(0.993, f."age_in_years_at_screening")
        ELSE NULL
    END AS "egfr_ml_min_1_73m_2"
FROM
    temp_cohort c
JOIN
    final_master_table f ON c."respondent_sequence_number" = f."respondent_sequence_number";

-- Step 4.5.2: Calculate Urine albumin-to-creatinine ratio (UACR)
CREATE TEMP TABLE temp_uacr AS
SELECT
    c."respondent_sequence_number",
    (100.0 * f."albumin_urine_mg_l" / f."creatinine_urine_mg_dl") AS "urine_albumin_to_creatinine_ratio_mg_g"
FROM
    temp_cohort c
JOIN
    final_master_table f ON c."respondent_sequence_number" = f."respondent_sequence_number"
WHERE
    f."creatinine_urine_mg_dl" IS NOT NULL AND f."creatinine_urine_mg_dl" > 0; -- Avoid division by zero

-- Step 4.5.3: Determine presence of kidney disease
CREATE TEMP TABLE temp_presence_of_kidney_disease AS
SELECT
    c."respondent_sequence_number",
    CASE
        WHEN e."egfr_ml_min_1_73m_2" < 60 OR u."urine_albumin_to_creatinine_ratio_mg_g" >= 30 THEN 1
        ELSE 0
    END AS "presence_of_kidney_disease"
FROM
    temp_cohort c
LEFT JOIN
    temp_egfr e ON c."respondent_sequence_number" = e."respondent_sequence_number"
LEFT JOIN
    temp_uacr u ON c."respondent_sequence_number" = u."respondent_sequence_number";

-- ========== STEP 5: Final Table ==========
CREATE TEMP TABLE temp_final_table AS
SELECT
    c."respondent_sequence_number",
    r."race",
    a."age",
    g."gender",
    w."weight_adjusted_waist_ratio",
    k."presence_of_kidney_disease"
FROM
    temp_cohort c
LEFT JOIN
    temp_race r ON c."respondent_sequence_number" = r."respondent_sequence_number"
LEFT JOIN
    temp_age a ON c."respondent_sequence_number" = a."respondent_sequence_number"
LEFT JOIN
    temp_gender g ON c."respondent_sequence_number" = g."respondent_sequence_number"
LEFT JOIN
    temp_weight_adjusted_waist_ratio w ON c."respondent_sequence_number" = w."respondent_sequence_number"
LEFT JOIN
    temp_presence_of_kidney_disease k ON c."respondent_sequence_number" = k."respondent_sequence_number";

    summarize_variable <- function(column, name) {
    n_unique <- length(unique(na.omit(column)))
    na_count <- sum(is.na(column))

    if (name %in% identifier_vars) {
        category <- "identifier"
        summary_info <- paste0("Total rows = ", nrow(cohort))

        # Assign its special role (e.g., "outcome", "mediator")

        # Generate a summary based on its underlying data type
        underlying_type <- case_when(
        n_unique == 2                                 ~ "binary",

        is.character(column) | is.factor(column)      ~ "categorical",

        )

        if (underlying_type == "numerical") {
        mean_val <- round(mean(column, na.rm = TRUE), 3)
        sd_val   <- round(sd(column, na.rm = TRUE), 3)
        summary_info <- paste0("mean = ", mean_val, ", sd = ", sd_val)
        } else if (underlying_type %in% c("categorical", "binary")) {
        tbl <- prop.table(table(column)) * 100
        tbl <- round(tbl, 1)
        summary_info <- paste0(names(tbl), ": ", tbl, "%", collapse = "; ")
        } else {
        summary_info <- NA
        }

    

    } else if (name %in% weight_vars) {
        category <- "weight"
        summary_info <- "Weight variable" 
    

    } else {
        # This block handles regular predictors
        category <- case_when(
        n_unique == 2                                 ~ "binary",
        is.numeric(column) & n_unique > 2             ~ "numerical",
        is.character(column) | is.factor(column)      ~ "categorical",
        TRUE                                          ~ "other"
        )

        if (category == "numerical") {
        mean_val <- round(mean(column, na.rm = TRUE), 3)

        summary_info <- paste0("mean = ", mean_val, ", sd = ", sd_val)

        tbl <- prop.table(table(column)) * 100
        tbl <- round(tbl, 1)
        summary_info <- paste0(names(tbl), ": ", tbl, "%", collapse = "; ")
        } else {
        summary_info <- NA
        }
    }

    data.frame(
        variable   = name,
        category   = category,

        na_count   = na_count,

    )
    }

    # Convert binary/categorical variables to factor if not already
    for (var in factor_candidates) {

    # Try to find preferred reference
    preferred_order <- c("healthy", "none", "control", "reference", "ref", "normal","Q1", "low", "0", "1")
    matches <- tolower(levels_vec)  # lower case to standardize
    ref_level <- NA  # default

    for (keyword in preferred_order) {
    idx <- which(grepl(keyword, matches, ignore.case = TRUE))
    if (length(idx) > 0) {

    }
    }

    if (is.na(ref_level)) {

        ref_level <- names(level_counts)[which.max(level_counts)]
    }

    # Set reference level
    df[[col]] <- relevel(df[[col]], ref = ref_level)

    # Record reference level
    reference_levels <- bind_rows(

        tibble(variable = col, reference_level = ref_level)
    )
    }
